# Limits Reference

Every size and count in Plux is governed by one registry, `schema/limits.json` (`LIM-001`, spec §30.4). Limits are set per installation, organisation, app and plugin, and a lower level can only tighten a limit set above it (`LIM-002`). Publication fails when a limit is exceeded and warns at the warning threshold — by default 80% of the limit (`LIM-003`).

| Key | Unit | Default | Warning | Maximum | Scopes | Phase | Requirements | Description |

| `action.runTimeout` | milliseconds | 120000 | 80% | 3600000 | installation, organization, app, plugin | P5 | ACT-005 | Time one action run may take. |
| `action.stepTimeout` | milliseconds | 30000 | 80% | 600000 | installation, organization, app, plugin | P5 | ACT-005 | Time one action step may take. |
